note: Archive name stems probed at repo.magento.com/patch/<stem>-<mon>-<year>.zip. These are upstream release identifiers including the patch level, which the bulletin's solution version omits: the September archive for the 2.4.8 line is 2-4-8-p5-sep-2026.zip, while the bulletin calls that version 2.4.8-2026-sep. Update this list when Adobe cuts a new p-release for a line. detect-security.js warns when the previous month returns no hits, which is what a stale list looks like. 2.4.4-2.4.6 are Adobe Commerce only from APSB26-138 on and their public archives 404, so they are not listed.
